entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It must be tough having to study for an[n]elite university, huh?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I've never asked you about your plans[n]for the future. Why do you want to go[n]to a top university?
I have to say something... quickly!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, an elite university[n]would certainly have a strong network of alumni.
I was somehow able to maintain[n]her trust!

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...THAT's why you want to go to an elite[n]university? That's so ridiculous it's not[n]even funny.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Did you think you could fool me with[n]an answer that was obviously made up[n]on the spot?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I can't trust you at all. Go home.
Takemi is starting to lose her trust[n]in me...
I have to regain her trust...
